review_findings: replay_ssh_diagnostic now limits rc to -31..255, null only with timeout, stdout to 65536 bytes and stderr to 1048576 bytes, and enforces rc/category/observed-line-stage consistency. Fixed enum and numeric fields prevent arbitrary exception or raw SSH text in published failure diagnostics.

validate_instance_diagnostic now enforces local REJECT, SSH launch, verified SSH proof, post-SSH guards and positive route as a monotonic sequence. It rejects the v3 false PROVEN at NONE case and similar impossible states. A line-SEEN stage remains an observed parser marker, not remote identity proof.

The v2 failed run and consumed nonce remain locked by terminal/peer/root NO_GO hashes; v3 rejected peer is pinned. v4 has separate peer/release/START/TERMINAL names. Success retains strict safe full-line positive-route replay and host-key/publickey/numeric-UID SSH witness replay.

Exact ssh/nc binaries, ED25519 host-key pin, /dev/null SSH config, loopback SOCKS ProxyCommand, remote LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/id -u only, process/loopback cleanup and no HK01/graph/device/container/namespace/global proxy write gates remain in the runner.
capture_memory_limit_assessment: subprocess.communicate(timeout=25) is not a streaming or in-memory byte cap; the 65536/1048576 limits apply only when constructing and publishing the diagnostic after capture. This does not defeat the narrow code-only gate for one fixed read-only identity command through a pinned host, but root must not describe it as a hard memory bound. A streaming cap is the next hardening item if the release requires adversarial-output resource isolation or if output approaches these bounds; oversized output must remain NO_GO, never truncated to a success proof.
remaining_runtime_unknowns: No selected real node or gz02 SSH has run in v4. Exact real banner/host-key/auth/UID and positive route remain unknown until a separately released one-shot run; v2's failure substage remains UNKNOWN and cannot be inferred from v4 fixtures.
